confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate. No live listings, booking pages, or city-price web sources were used; web search was used only for the FX observation. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the more reliable tier, and restaurant prices are assumed tax-inclusive, as is customary in Japan. Accommodation is least certain because July is high season (Gion Matsuri and the start of summer holidays), so nightly rates vary widely by date and neighborhood. Yen prices were converted at an assumed rate of roughly 150 yen per USD, without a separate JPY rate check. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail roughly twice beer, wine glass roughly 1.7 times beer) because direct bar pricing knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Restaurant and cafe levels were benchmarked against Japan's other major visitor cities, such as Osaka and Tokyo, and accommodation was adjusted upward for Kyoto's July high season.
